EXPERIENCE Buddha's ENLIGHTENMENT at Mahabodhi Temple Bodh Gaya
Mahabodhi Temple, Bodh Gaya – The Land of Enlightenment | Documentary Travel Vlog |
Welcome to the sacred land of Bodh Gaya, where Prince Siddhartha became the Buddha. In this documentary-style travel vlog, we take you on a spiritual and historical journey through one of the most revered Buddhist sites in the world – the Mahabodhi Temple.
In this video, you will explore: The sacred Bodhi Tree – where Buddha attained enlightenment
The ancient Mahabodhi Temple complex – a UNESCO World Heritage Site
